_comment: ZR_WallTiles: glazed 15 cm wall tiles in a regular grid; 2.4 m per tile. The maps are empty on purpose: the main session uploads assets/textures/out/materials/ZR_MAT_WallTiles_Color.png, _Normal.png and _Rough.png and writes the three rbxassetid values here (never invent ids). World.applyWear skips this variant while ColorMap is empty, so nothing breaks before then.
